<document name="Fernwood-contract-policy.pdf" pages="3">
[Page 1]
Fernwood Labs — Customer contract policy
1. Customer tiers and notice
Every customer contract is either Standard or Enterprise. Enterprise customers
are those on a yearly value of $50,000 or more, or with a signed Enterprise order
form.
Notice periods: Enterprise contracts need 90 days' notice before they renew or end.
Standard contracts need 30 days' notice.
Every contract has one owner at Fernwood, who looks after the customer and the
renewal.

[Page 2]
2. Approvals and renewals
Contracts over $50,000 a year go to legal review before they are signed. Lena Ortiz
does the legal review and approves it or sends it back.
The owner is reminded 90 days before a contract's notice date, so there is time to
agree the renewal.
Ending a contract over $50,000 needs the founder's approval before it is ended.

[Page 3]
3. New customers
Before a new customer signs, we run a credit check through our credit bureau
service, and the result is kept with the contract.
Questions about this policy go to Krishna in Operations.
</document>

Latest message from Wade Wilson:
Enterprise customers have 90 days notice. Use our policy for the rest.
